title: 台北捷運淡水信義線
summary: 以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。
summaryEn: Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 班距與有效運能與車門交換與停站時間
stages.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity & Door exchange and dwell time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「班距與有效運能」與「車門交換與停站時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Headway and usable capacity" and "Door exchange and dwell time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「班距與有效運能」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Headway and usable capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 讓尖峰轉乘需求與線上可用運能使用相同的時間窗比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「班距與有效運能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Compare peak interchange demand and usable line capacity over the same time window. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Headway and usable capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「班距與有效運能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Headway and usable capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 班距與有效運能
knowledge.text: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。
knowledge.textEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「台北捷運淡水信義線」的「班距與有效運能：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「列車性能與時刻表室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Headway and usable capacity: mechanism and system paths” in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Train performance and timetable room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Headway and usable capacity" is correct?
options: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
optionsEn: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
quiz.explanation: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距與有效運能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway and usable capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16042.78 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16042.78 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16042.78 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16042.78 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「班距與有效運能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Headway and usable capacity", which statement holds?
options: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train。
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距與有效運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway and usable capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway and usable capacity"?
options: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距與有效運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway and usable capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：讓尖峰轉乘需求與線上可用運能使用相同的時間窗比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare peak interchange demand and usable line capacity over the same time window.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。
knowledge.textEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「班距與有效運能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Headway and usable capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
quiz.explanation: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 把樓梯附近的車門視為獨立服務群，檢查不均勻上車。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Treat doors beside the stairs as a distinct service group and test uneven boarding. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車門交換與停站時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Door exchange and dwell time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車門交換與停站時間
knowledge.text: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。
knowledge.textEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door exchange and dwell time" is correct?
options: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移
停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
optionsEn: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 270至 270 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.0625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 270, to 270 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.0625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 270至 270 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.0625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 270, to 270 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.0625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車門交換與停站時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Door exchange and dwell time", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s。
換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門交換與停站時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Door exchange and dwell time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。
knowledge.textEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Door exchange and dwell time"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
quiz.explanation: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Door exchange and dwell time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把樓梯附近的車門視為獨立服務群，檢查不均勻上車。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treat doors beside the stairs as a distinct service group and test uneven boarding.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。
knowledge.textEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車門交換與停站時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Door exchange and dwell time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移
行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail.
quiz.explanation: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
